newsitem.title: USA: Donaldson to offer online training courses.
newsitem.headline: Donaldson to offer online training courses.

text.p: Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette on Monday said its Pershing division selected Princeton Learning Systems and KnowledgeSoft Inc to design and manage an online educational system for the financial services industry.

The service, available through the Internet or corporate intranets, would provide access to courses developed by leading publishers of online training content, such as Dearborn Financial Institute and Securities Education Institute.

The service is to be offered under a private label to Pershing customers and to other broker-dealers under the brand name of Financial Services University. Its launch is expected sometime during second quarter.
The firm said subscribers could customize the service by incorporating their own corporate identity and internal training programs.
